note: Follows the protocol cards: asks what they ate, reads the advice lines, brings the vet in, gives the call-back advice.
lines: Namaskara, animal helpline. Tell me, what happened?
Did they eat anything different today?
Jowar sprouts, okay. How long ago did they eat it?
Please move all the animals away from that field now, and do not pour anything into their mouths.
This is an emergency. I am sending the van and connecting the vet now. What is your name?
Tell me your phone number, please.
Nine nine zero zero one, two three four five six. Correct?
Have you given anything so far?
Let me read it back. Lakshmamma from Hosahalli, Ramanagara. Four goats ate young jowar one hour ago, trembling, breathing fast, one cannot stand. Is that correct?
The vet is coming on the line now. If it gets worse, or another animal falls sick, call us again. Goodbye.
